versions.changelog:
Web interface added for daily-assistant with new front-end assets.

- Introduced web server (src/web.py) for browser-based interaction.
- Added static files: app.js, index.html, and style.css for the front end.
- Updated README and SKILL.md to reflect web interface availability.
- Existing Python core and setup scripts updated to support the new web functionality.

- Added new features and improvements across core, server, and setup modules.
- Updated version to 2.1.0.
- Documentation refreshed for clarity, with enhanced setup and usage instructions.
- Improved install and configuration automation via setup script.
Task deduplication: inherited tasks marked as [>] are excluded from overdue/history queries
Remove test files and internal project documents from published package

Initial release of Daily Assistant MCP Server.

- AI-powered daily task manager with deterministic Python operations (no token cost)
- Recommends next task, inherits unfinished tasks, checks for overdue, generates reviews
- Simple setup for Windows/macOS/Linux; no external dependencies like Obsidian
- Tasks and dashboards use easy-to-edit plain Markdown files
- Provides tools for daily reviews, detecting overdue tasks, and intelligent task recommendations
